metrics.name: Duration
metrics.description: Total duration of the audio file

metrics.name: Sample Rate
metrics.description: Audio sample rate

metrics.name: Channels
metrics.description: Number of audio channels

metrics.name: Peak Amplitude
metrics.description: Maximum absolute sample value (0–1 scale)

metrics.name: Peak Level
metrics.description: Peak level in dBFS (0 dBFS = full scale)

metrics.name: RMS Level
metrics.description: Root-mean-square energy level in dBFS

metrics.name: Crest Factor
metrics.description: Peak-to-RMS ratio. High values indicate highly dynamic or sparse signal.

metrics.name: DC Offset
metrics.description: Mean sample value. Non-zero indicates a DC component.

metrics.name: Silence Ratio
metrics.description: Percentage of samples below -60 dB (near silence)

metrics.name: Dynamic Range (simple)
metrics.description: Difference between peak and RMS level

metrics.name: Clipping Detected
metrics.description: 1 if any samples appear clipped (>=0.999 full scale)

metrics.name: Zero Crossing Rate
metrics.description: Rate of sign changes (correlated with pitch/noisiness)

metrics.name: Integrated Loudness (LUFS)
metrics.description: ITU-R BS.1770 / EBU R128 integrated loudness (gated)

metrics.name: Loudness Range (LRA)
metrics.description: EBU R128 loudness range: dynamic variation of the program

metrics.name: Max Short-Term Loudness
metrics.description: Maximum 3-second sliding window loudness

metrics.name: True Peak
metrics.description: Inter-sample peak level (4x oversampled). Streaming limit: -1 dBTP

metrics.name: Spectral Centroid
metrics.description: Weighted mean frequency (brightness indicator)

metrics.name: Spectral Bandwidth
metrics.description: Weighted standard deviation around centroid

metrics.name: Spectral Rolloff (95%)
metrics.description: Frequency below which 95% of spectral energy is concentrated

metrics.name: Spectral Flatness
metrics.description: Ratio of geometric to arithmetic mean of spectrum (0 dB = white noise, low = tonal)

metrics.name: Spectral Flux
metrics.description: Mean frame-to-frame spectral change (higher = more dynamic/noisy)

metrics.name: Spectral Skewness
metrics.description: Asymmetry of the spectral distribution

metrics.name: Spectral Entropy
metrics.description: Randomness/uniformity of spectral energy (higher = more noise-like)

metrics.name: Effective Bandwidth
metrics.description: Frequency range containing significant energy (>-30 dB from peak)

metrics.name: Estimated Fundamental (F0)
metrics.description: Estimated pitch / fundamental frequency via autocorrelation

metrics.name: Band Energy: Sub-Bass (20–80 Hz)
metrics.description: Proportion of energy in sub-bass band

metrics.name: Band Energy: Bass (80–300 Hz)
metrics.description: Proportion of energy in bass band

metrics.name: Band Energy: Low-Mid (300–2000 Hz)
metrics.description: Proportion of energy in low-mid band (speech fundamentals)

metrics.name: Band Energy: Presence (2–6 kHz)
metrics.description: Proportion of energy in presence/intelligibility band

metrics.name: Band Energy: Air (6–20 kHz)
metrics.description: Proportion of energy in high-frequency 'air' band

metrics.name: High-Frequency Content (HFC)
metrics.description: Frequency-weighted energy sum (sensitive to high-frequency transients)

metrics.name: Speech/Activity Ratio
metrics.description: Fraction of time with active speech/sound (energy-based VAD)

metrics.name: Attack Time
metrics.description: Time to reach 90% of peak energy from start

metrics.name: Temporal Centroid
metrics.description: Energy-weighted center of mass in time

metrics.name: Num Pauses (>100ms)
metrics.description: Count of silent pauses longer than 100ms

metrics.name: Mean Pause Duration
metrics.description: Average duration of detected pauses

metrics.name: Max Pause Duration
metrics.description: Length of the longest detected pause

metrics.name: Energy Variance
metrics.description: Variance of frame energy — high = dynamic, low = monotone

metrics.name: ZCR Mean
metrics.description: Mean zero-crossing rate across frames

metrics.name: ZCR Variance
metrics.description: Variance of zero-crossing rate (higher = more varied texture)

metrics.name: Estimated Noise Floor
metrics.description: Energy of quietest 10% of frames (noise floor estimate)

metrics.name: Estimated SNR
metrics.description: Signal-to-noise ratio: active speech vs noise floor (energy-based)

metrics.name: Spectral SNR
metrics.description: SNR estimated from spectral power of active vs quiet frames

metrics.name: Harmonic-to-Noise Ratio (HNR)
metrics.description: Ratio of harmonic (periodic) energy to noise. High = cleaner voiced speech.

metrics.name: Near-Clipped Samples
metrics.description: Number of samples at or near full scale (potential clipping)

metrics.name: Detected Dropouts
metrics.description: Count of sudden near-silence drops in otherwise active audio (possible glitches)

metrics.name: MFCC-1 Mean
metrics.description: Mean of MFCC coefficient 1

metrics.description: Mean of MFCC coefficient 2

metrics.name: F1-Region Energy (300–1000 Hz)
metrics.description: Energy in first formant region (vowel quality)

metrics.name: F2-Region Energy (1–2.5 kHz)
metrics.description: Energy in second formant region

metrics.name: F3-Region Energy (2.5–3.5 kHz)
metrics.description: Energy in third formant region (voice timbre)

metrics.name: Voiced/Unvoiced Ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of voiced to unvoiced frames (correlated with speaking style)

metrics.name: Speech-Band SNR (300 Hz – 3.4 kHz)
metrics.description: SNR restricted to the telephone/speech band (classic intelligibility range)

metrics.name: Estimated MOS (non-intrusive proxy)
metrics.description: Heuristic MOS estimate (SNR + spectral shape). For accurate MOS install `dnsmos`.
metrics.warning: Note: proxy only — use DNSMOS ONNX model for accurate MOS

metrics.name: P.563 Proxy (NB Quality Estimate)
metrics.description: Narrowband non-intrusive quality proxy (P.563-inspired heuristic)
metrics.warning: Proxy only — install `itu-p563` for true P.563

metrics.name: PESQ (ITU-T P.862)
metrics.description: Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality — requires --reference

metrics.name: STOI (Short-Time Objective Intelligibility)
metrics.description: Speech intelligibility score [0–1] — requires --reference

metrics.name: SI-SDR (Scale-Invariant SDR)
metrics.description: Scale-invariant signal-to-distortion ratio — requires --reference

metrics.name: Log-Spectral Distance
metrics.description: Spectral distortion vs reference — requires --reference
